subtitle: Practice skills. Prove growth.
promotionalText: Turn a goal into deliberate practice, then prove progress with observable evidence and structured human review.
description:
Karteria turns improvement into something you can practice, observe, and prove.

START WITH AN IDENTITY
Define who you want to become, then break that direction into levels, subskills, checkpoints, and private daily reps. Each practice plan includes a two-minute fallback and a simple rule: never miss twice.

CREATE AN EVIDENCE CONTRACT
Before a checkpoint, define three observable standards and capture a baseline. Your contract makes success specific before you submit the result.

REVIEWED BY PEOPLE
Optional anonymous peer review gives three calibrated reviewers the same before-and-after evidence and rubric. Each reviewer marks every criterion Met, Not met, or Not shown. Two complete passes verify the level. AI can check evidence coverage before submission, but it never votes or replaces a reviewer.

PRACTICE STAYS PRIVATE
Daily reps, schedules, notes, and your Journey remain private. Karteria has no follower counts, public feed, likes, chat, or popularity leaderboard. Invite-only trusted review is available for people aged 13 to 17; the anonymous exchange is limited to adults.

LEARN FROM THE RESULT
A failed criterion becomes the focus of your next practice cycle. Verified levels preserve the baseline, checkpoint, rubric, and outcome in a clear growth timeline.

FREE INCLUDES
- One active goal
- Daily deliberate practice
- Evidence contracts and before/after comparison
- Human peer review and trusted review
- Private Journey and iCloud sync

KARTERIA PRO
- Unlimited active goals
- Cross-goal insights and advanced reviews
- Private 60-second evidence tools
- Unbranded growth videos and PDF portfolio exports

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings.
